newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT - Australian 10-year bond held at 92.340.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Australian 10-year bond held at 92.340.

text.p: *Australian bond futures consolidated Friday's sharp dayside gains in after-hours trading with the 10-year bond contract remaining restrained at 92.340.
Australian bond futures consolidated Friday's sharp dayside gains in after hours trading with the 10-year bond contract remaining restrained at 92.340.
The contract ended SYCOM at 92.330, up from Friday's 92.320 pit close and after support held towards 92.250.

The contract needs to overcome initial resistance at 92.360 before the market can extend the rally and break the restraint of this month's rising channel, with further chart points seen at 92.435 and 92.470, analysts said.
The market remained underpinned by a firm U.S. debt market following remarks by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.

Greenspan was initially seen as hinting that the Fed may not tighten policy later this month, but as usual his remarks were fairly guarded and by the end of the U.S. session, some analysts believed he was pointing to a tightening.
Meanwhile, the key local event this week will be Tuesday's Federal 1997/98 budget which is expected to market friendly with little or zero net bond issuance seen being projected.
March housing finance is due at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) which are forecast to rise 1.0 percent after the 6.9 percent fall the previous month, according to a Reuters survey of economists.
